boundary: This is an exact A8-equivariant identification of all 336 Singer normalizers. It locates the 56 quotient and six-element fibres concretely, but does not identify the internal 280-dimensional module with a specific W33 center-quad or E6 weight object.

objectwise_model.objects: pairs (A,P) where A is a 3-subset of an 8-set and P is one of the six Sylow-5 subgroups on the complementary 5-set

representation_bridge.E7_boundary: The E7 minuscule 56 restricts at the A7 horizon as Lambda^2(8)+Lambda^6(8)=28+28, not as this transitive 3-subset module. The new 56 is therefore an exact A8/Johnson object, not automatically the E7 fundamental representation.
representation_bridge.Lambda3_boundary: The 56 labels are the weight-indexing set for Lambda^3 of an 8-dimensional basis, but the Johnson module is unsigned. A transposition inside a triple fixes the Johnson basis vector and negates the exterior basis vector, so the two S8-modules are not equivalent without an orientation double cover.
representation_bridge.block_constant_module: unsigned permutation module on the 56 three-subsets, decomposing 1+7+20+28
representation_bridge.internal_module: 56 copies of the five-dimensional augmentation module of the six-pentagon fibre; globally 45+conj(45)+56+64+70

six_fibre.permutation_image: S5 in its transitive degree-six action on the six Sylow-5 subgroups
